<mxfile host="Electron" agent="hand-authored"> <diagram id="staleness-sweep-1136" name="staleness sweep"> <mxGraphModel grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1160" pageHeight="700" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="title" parent="1" style="text;html=1;fontSize=16;fontStyle=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;" value="machine staleness sweep (#1136) — presence lastSeenAt + threshold sweep become the second truth source for machine.online" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="34" width="1080" x="40" y="16" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="daemon" parent="1" style="rounded=1;html=1;verticalAlign=top;align=left;spacing=8;strokeColor=#82b366;fillColor=#d5e8d4;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;whiteSpace=wrap;" value="daemon (alive)

(~3 min worst-case detection)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="64" width="230" x="680" y="200" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="fam" parent="1" style="rounded=1;html=1;verticalAlign=top;align=left;spacing=8;strokeColor=#9673a6;fillColor=#e6d0de;fontSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;container=1;collapsible=0;" value="bounded-wait family (#862 / #864 / #881) — all keyed on machine.online" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="190" width="250" x="680" y="320" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="f1" parent="fam" style="rounded=1;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#9673a6;fontSize=11;align=left;spacing=6;whiteSpace=wrap;" value="pinned-offline grace (10 min) → named failure" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="218" x="16" y="36" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="f2" parent="fam" style="rounded=1;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#9673a6;fontSize=11;align=left;spacing=6;whiteSpace=wrap;" value="claimed-step release (heartbeat stale ∧ machine offline) → pending" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="48" width="218" x="16" y="84" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="f3" parent="fam" style="rounded=1;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#9673a6;fontSize=11;align=left;spacing=6;whiteSpace=wrap;" value="zero-online fail (120 s) · session affinity gate" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="48" width="218" x="16" y="140" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="note" parent="1" style="rounded=1;html=1;verticalAlign=top;align=left;spacing=8;strokeColor=#666666;fillColor=#f5f5f5;fontSize=11;whiteSpace=wrap;" value="discipline: the sweep flips online only — steps keep their own release criteria (no pre-emption).

div.div:
discipline: the sweep flips online only — steps keep their own release criteria (no pre-emption).
lastSeenAt NULL (pre-upgrade rows) is never swept — next presence fills it (≤ 30 s), zero false-kill window on deploy.
150 s = 30 s presence + 15 s tick + jitter headroom (Multica parity: RuntimeClaimFreshnessSeconds = 150 s).
